summaries.zh: Self-contained browser runtime plugin for DeepSeek Harness — bundles Playwright (chromium) and OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies, exposes a browser service and interactive browser tools.
summaries.en: Self-contained browser runtime plugin for DeepSeek Harness — bundles Playwright (chromium) and OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies, exposes a browser service and interactive browser tools.
